name: wunderlust
description: Hand-picked creative references for design, motion and AI: award-winning sites, animation and 3D libraries, UI components and AI tools, each with the one idea worth exploring.

interface.longDescription:
Wunderlust is a hand-picked, always-growing stash of creative references for people who design and build: award-winning websites, motion and animation libraries, 3D and WebGL tools, UI components, inspiration galleries, AI tools, agents and coding skills.

Every reference is checked and written up by hand in plain English: what it is, what it is for, the one idea worth exploring in it, typical uses, benefits and caveats, with the official link.

Ask for references while you design or build. Search the stash in your own words or by category, tag, design pattern or editorial pick; read the full write-up of a reference with its caveats; find similar references; get a random selection for inspiration; or read a collection someone shared from Wunderlust as a brief. Answers with two or more references include a board link that opens them side by side in the browser, with video.

It only reads the public stash. It needs no account and never changes anything.
capabilities: Search hand-picked creative references by text, category, tag or design pattern
Read the full write-up of a reference, with its caveats and official link
Find references similar to one you like
Read a collection someone shared from Wunderlust
